messages.author: 8b2310c4a535a07b
messages.subject: Inquiry about methylKit::normalize.Coverage()
parts:
Dear all,

I have a quick question concerning normalization.

Do we need to perform methylKit::normalize.Coverage(), before methylKit::filterByCoverage() ?
When is it necessary to do normalization?

Thank you
All the best,
Sarah

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Inquiry about methylKit::normalize.Coverage()
parts:
I think it is not necessary to do normalization if the coverage values are systematically different for samples, this has to be tested maybe with simulation data for now let's assume it is not. filtering works for RRBS mostly when you have high read counts and it is not a good idea to remove PCR duplicates with RRBS due to the nature of the protocol. There is no guideline but it might be a good idea to remove the 95 or 99th percentile if you can't remove the PCR duplicates. 

Best,
altuna
